synopsis: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms is an American fantasy drama television series that serves as a prequel to Game of Thrones and is part of George R. R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire franchise, focusing on Ser Duncan 'Dunk' the Tall and his squire, Aegon 'Egg' Targaryen.
setting: The show takes place in the Seven Kingdoms during a time period that predates the events of Game of Thrones.
